lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a non-linear grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits and anterior to the pectoral fin; spatial density increases towards the ventral boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, most notably in the mid-flank region, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible in the upper mid-section of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing surface and a shadowed trough below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark elongated mark is visible above the primary remora attachment point, possibly indicative of a healed surface lesion or pigmentation irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Echeneidae individuals: one larger dark-toned specimen attached to the upper lateral flank and one smaller, high-luminance specimen swimming ventrally to the pectoral fin.
